Our third annual Animal Fest brought guest posing, competitions, vendors and the whole crew together under one roof at Animal Paradise.

The recap

Our biggest day of the year.

On October 10, 2026, Animal Paradise hosted the third edition of Animal Fest. Competitors, guest posers, vendors and members came together for the biggest day on our calendar.

  • Vendors on site
  • Medals for competitors and the Animal Fest III champion belt
